### Prayers
- Prayer-time notifications with the adhan of Makkah or Madinah. The first time you set your city, a single question asks which prayers should call you — the five fard prayers come pre-selected — and which sound: Adhan Makkah, Adhan Madinah, beep, system or silent. Fine-tune any of it, per prayer, in Prayer Settings. - A brighter prayer sky, the countdown and the next prayer side by side, and a timeline whose gradient advances with the clock.
### Kahf Guard Premium
- Protection is now part of Kahf Guard Premium in personal mode: app and website blocking, the Shorts/Reels and risky-word guards, time limits, schedules and templates, and uninstall protection. A subscription sheet explains everything the moment you reach for one of them. - Safe Internet, Habits, Prayers and today's analytics stay free.
### Fixes
- Screen-time reports no longer count the time the Mac spends at the login window.
